title: Keep Tarium project manifests and public membership claims accurate
abstract: Keep local Tarium manifests and publicly advertised ontology and gallery entry points consistent with published project resources and actual registry state; never claim a project is enrolled merely because it has a template or is compatible with Tarium.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
